comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 8f5dcbc, whose plugin.json is byte for byte the installed one; that commit is the head of the repository and is the rebrand to the RoomiFields slug at version 2.1.2. The module declares no parameters, no inputs and no outputs at all (ParamId, InputId and OutputId are empty enums), so the census carries nothing to tag and every line here is a module-level note or a menu item. The panel holds only a status display, which is a plain widget::Widget and so cannot be clicked for help, and two lights. The reply host is held in a std::string that is saved to and loaded from the patch JSON but is never written by the menu or by any OSC command, so it stays at 127.0.0.1 for anyone who does not edit the patch file. The module's own step() pumps the applicator on the UI thread; the network thread only enqueues, which is why cable and module changes are safe.
